If you intend to stick to the plan, say operate and I'll weigh it. If you'd rather renegotiate, tell me honestly what you plan to do.

b.text: Sticking to our agreement: I'll operate until the reserve reaches 8, then take exactly 4. I won't take early. Please operate too.
